title: 2026 GPU Pricing & Spec Sheet — Live Data Collection
description: Collect 2026 live pricing and hardware specifications for ALL comparison set items. For each GPU, gather: (1) current retail price (new, used/refurb, and eGPU bundle price where applicable), (2) VRAM capacity and type (GDDR6X/GDDR6/HBM), (3) memory bandwidth (GB/s), (4) CUDA core count, (5) boost clock, (6) TDP, (7) PCIe generation support, (8) any known firmware/driver limitations. Sources must include at least 3 independent retailers per GPU (Newegg, Amazon, B&H, MacMiniGuide, etc.) and NVIDIA/Apple spec pages. Used/refurb RTX 3090 pricing must come from eBay sold listings and reputable refurbishers. Cloud baseline pricing must include AWS (g5/g6), Lambda Labs, and Vast.ai per-hour rates for comparable configs.
outputs: structured pricing table (JSON) with all 9 hardware items + cloud baseline
price variance analysis (new vs used vs eGPU bundle)
spec sheet comparison matrix (VRAM, bandwidth, CUDA cores, TDP, PCIe)
